summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Alpha Technology Group Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting a strategic partnership with Wai Yuen Tong Medicine Co. Ltd. to launch an AI + Blockchain traceability system for traditional Chinese medicine. The filing describes a commercial collaboration, not a merger, acquisition, or any special situation corporate event. It announces a product deployment, not a change in control, shareholder distribution, activist campaign, or restructuring. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or regulatory clocks. As a standard current report of a business development, it falls outside special-situations categories.
